name: Burg Extrapolator
summary: This EA uses the Burg method (Maximum Entropy Method) for spectral analysis and extrapolation of price series. It decomposes the price signal into its frequency components using autoregressive modeling, then forecasts future price movement by extrapolating those components forward. Trading signals are generated based on the extrapolated price direction.
summary_zh: 该EA使用Burg方法（最大熵法）对价格序列进行频谱分析和外推预测。通过自回归建模将价格信号分解为频率成分，然后外推这些成分来预测未来价格走势，并根据外推方向生成交易信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Burg谱分析方法，这是一种最大熵谱估计技术，通过对价格序列进行自回归(AR)建模来提取信号的频率成分。EA将历史价格数据分解为多个正弦波分量，每个分量具有特定的振幅、频率和相位，然后将这些分量向前外推以预测未来价格走势。入场条件基于外推预测的方向：当预测价格上升时开多仓，当预测价格下降时开空仓。出场条件通常依赖反向预测信号或固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金的简单仓位计算。资金管理相对简单，缺乏动态风险调整机制。这种方法本质上是假设价格序列具有周期性特征可以外推，属于统计学上的均值回归思路，但在强趋势市场中可能失效。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the Burg spectral analysis method, a maximum entropy spectral estimation technique that performs autoregressive (AR) modeling on price series to extract frequency components. The EA decomposes historical price data into multiple sinusoidal components, each with specific amplitude, frequency, and phase, then extrapolates these components forward to forecast future price movement. Entry conditions are based on the extrapolated prediction direction: long positions when the forecast predicts rising prices, short positions when the forecast predicts falling prices. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse prediction signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses fixed lots or simple equity-based calculation. Money management is relatively basic, lacking dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms. This approach inherently assumes price series possess periodic characteristics that can be extrapolated, following a mean reversion philosophy, but may fail in strong trending markets.

parameters.description: AR模型阶数，决定频谱分辨率
parameters.description_en: AR model order determining spectral resolution

parameters.name: ExtrapolationBars
parameters.description_en: Number of bars for extrapolation forecast

parameters.name: HistoryBars
parameters.description: 用于分析的历史K线数量
parameters.description_en: Number of historical bars for analysis

pros: 使用先进的频谱分析方法，理论基础扎实，Burg方法在信号处理领域有成熟应用
能够捕捉价格序列中的隐含周期性特征，对震荡市场有较好的预测能力
数学模型透明，预测过程可解释性强，不同于黑盒机器学习方法
pros_en: Employs advanced spectral analysis with solid theoretical foundation; the Burg method has mature applications in signal processing
Capable of capturing implicit periodic characteristics in price series, providing good prediction in ranging markets
Transparent mathematical model with interpretable prediction process, unlike black-box machine learning approaches
cons: 频谱外推假设价格具有周期性，在强趋势市场或突发事件中预测会严重偏离
缺乏完善的风险管理机制，止损止盈参数默认为0，存在巨大亏损风险
AR模型阶数选择敏感，过高会导致过拟合，过低则无法捕捉重要频率成分
cons_en: Spectral extrapolation assumes price periodicity; predictions severely deviate in strong trending markets or during sudden events
Lacks robust risk management mechanisms; stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, posing significant loss risk
AR model order selection is sensitive; too high causes overfitting, too low fails to capture important frequency components
improvements: 增加自适应模型阶数选择机制，如基于AIC/BIC准则自动确定最优阶数
添加趋势过滤器，在强趋势市场中暂停交易或切换策略，避免外推失效
improvements_en: Add adaptive model order selection mechanism, such as AIC/BIC criterion-based automatic optimal order determination
Add trend filter to suspend trading or switch strategy in strong trending markets, avoiding extrapolation failure

risk_points: 止损默认为0，意味着没有硬性风险控制，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大
频谱外推方法在非平稳市场中预测不可靠，可能导致连续错误信号
risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, meaning no hard risk control; single trade loss can expand indefinitely
Spectral extrapolation is unreliable in non-stationary markets, potentially generating consecutive wrong signals

Trading signals are generated based on the extrapolated price direction.
